pixel_correspondence: nearest native B pixel; no depth interpolation
source_visibility: positive Mask + finite native Z inside original finite ROI/CAD limits; boundary retained for diagnostic
known_occlusion: first positive CAD hit, projected-A self z-buffer
uncertified_depth_order: residual magnitude/sign NEVER used to drop a candidate; mark ambiguity separately
bias_fit: NOT_PLANNED; design identifiability + Ring-based linearized diagnostic only; no corrected training inputs
ring_selection: NO residual-based agreement filter; native Ring depth only
model: official MonoSDFNetwork with official plain MLP branch; width256 x8, feature256, multires6, official rendering conf
source_pixel_selection: fixed RNG subselect within existing frozen E2 batch; no prediction-driven selection
